description: A perforated black base plate sits on the table with two loose bolts nearby, and a black upright bracket with a circular cutout is positioned at the back-right. The right hand reaches to the bracket, lifts it, sets it upright on the base plate, then uses fingertips to turn a small fastener on the bracket’s lower front—making several twisting motions to screw or tighten it—while the left hand stays low and mostly still without touching the parts.
